description:
Memco Personal Memory gives your AI assistants persistent memory about how you work. Preferences, habits, project context, and working style carry across any MCP-compatible agent harness. Every agent starts where the last one left off.

Your memories are private, hosted, and fully under your control. The Memco dashboard at memco.ai lets you view, edit, and delete individual memories at any time. There is no local setup, no file to manage, and no data locked inside a single tool.

Memco Personal Memory works alongside Memco Shared Memory. Personal memory holds what is yours: how you like responses formatted, your editor setup, your role and working context. Shared memory holds what your team should know: validated solutions, operational decisions, institutional knowledge. Same platform, complementary scopes. Use one or both.

Free to use; sign up at memco.ai.
